speak.title: Role-play: borrow it or buy it?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the friend who wants to buy
a.text: You want to go camping next weekend. You plan to buy a tent. Explain why owning one feels better, and ask your friend about any problems with borrowing.

b.text: You know a library where you can borrow a tent. Persuade your friend to try borrowing first. Answer their worries and say what you'd do together.

phrases: I was thinking of buying a tent.
Why don't we borrow one first?
That's a fair point, but it's cheaper.
I'd rather try it before I spend money.
Okay, let's give it a go.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did your friend decide to borrow or to buy, and why?
